criteria.rule: per element: abs_err <= abs_tol OR rel_err <= rel_tol

criteria.bit_identity: not required between these two implementations, and not generalised if seen

real_ad01.worst_err_note: the abs and rel maxima may come from different elements
real_ad01.argmax_note: argmax is not applicable to this model; absence is not a pass
